## What to build

Build the Frontier Reviewer decision path and tiered repair policy. Review outcomes should be evidence-based and should update the Issue Slice, Local Agent session, and mission summary consistently.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Review outcomes support Approved, Approved with limitations, Needs repair, Needs human review, and Rejected.
- [x] Missing or invalid evidence prevents Approved outcomes.
- [x] First rejection routes repair to the same Local Agent.
- [x] Second rejection routes repair to a fresh Local Agent.
- [x] Repeated architecture failure routes back to Frontier Architect revision.
- [x] Critical, security, or merge-risk failure escalates to the user.
source_issue.title: 06 — Frontier Review and Repair Policy

behavior: Completed user/assistant exchanges are retained separately and SHA-256 bound through worker evidence.

First repair continues retained history and agent identity when model/history permit; second or later terminal rejection in repair ancestry starts a fresh Local Agent with verified evidence reference.
Needs repair outcomes do not count as rejections. Current policy and fresh approval remain required.
Legacy absent/incomplete history, changed model and exhausted history budget start fresh with an explicit reason.
Referenced missing/corrupt history needed for continuation refuses before Start; old effects are never replayed.
Eight-message/512-KiB content limits reserve the existing 128-KiB answer budget; serialized file limit 4 MiB.
Evidence view shows fresh/continued identity. This is application-managed chat continuity, not proof of server-process reuse.
